component.name: UnsplashTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "work" end sub
sub work() cmd = m.top.command key = cfGet("unsplash_key", "") if cmd = invalid or cmd.kind = invalid then return if key = "" then m.top.result = { kind: cmd.kind, ok: false, error: "Add your Unsplash access key first." } return end if if cmd.kind = "photos" then photos(key) else if cmd.kind = "collections" then collections(key) else if cmd.kind = "ping" and cmd.url <> invalid then fetch(cmd.url, key) end if end sub
function fetch(url as String, key as String) as Object ut = CreateObject("roUrlTransfer") p = CreateObject("roMessagePort") ut.SetMessagePort(p) ut.SetCertificatesFile("common:/certs/ca-bundle.crt") ut.InitClientCertificates() ut.AddHeader("Authorization", "Client-ID " + key) ut.AddHeader("Accept-Version", "v1") ut.RetainBodyOnError(true) ut.SetUrl(url) if not ut.AsyncGetToString() then return { code: -1, body: "" } msg = wait(15000, p) if type(msg) = "roUrlEvent" then return { code: msg.GetResponseCode(), body: msg.GetString() } ut.AsyncCancel() return { code: 0, body: "" } end function
function problem(code as Integer) as String if code = 401 then return "Unsplash didn't accept the access key." if code = 403 then return "Unsplash's hourly limit is used up. Try again later." if code = 404 then return "Unsplash couldn't find that user or collection." if code <= 0 then return "Couldn't reach Unsplash. Is the TV online?" return "Unsplash returned an error (" + code.ToStr() + ")." end function
sub photos(key as String) src = cfGet("source", "cleanframe") url = "https://api.unsplash.com/photos/random?count=20&orientation=landscape&content_filter=high" if src = "all" then ids = [] cols = ParseJson(cfGet("unsplash_cols", "[]")) if cols <> invalid then for each c in cols ids.Push(c.id) end for end if if ids.Count() > 0 then url = url + "&collections=" + ids.Join(",") else url = url + "&query=landscape" else if src = "landscape" or src = "cleanframe" then url = url + "&query=landscape" else url = url + "&collections=" + src end if r = fetch(url, key) if r.code <> 200 then m.top.result = { kind: "photos", ok: false, error: problem(r.code) } return end if list = [] data = ParseJson(r.body) if data <> invalid then for each p in data if p.urls <> invalid and p.urls.raw <> invalid then author = "Unsplash" if p.user <> invalid and p.user.name <> invalid then author = p.user.name ping = "" if p.links <> invalid and p.links.download_location <> invalid then ping = p.links.download_location list.Push({ url: p.urls.raw + "&w=1920&h=1080&fit=crop&crop=entropy&fm=jpg&q=80", author: author, ping: ping }) end if end for end if if list.Count() > 0 then cfSet("unsplash_cache", FormatJson(list)) m.top.result = { kind: "photos", ok: list.Count() > 0, count: list.Count(), error: "No photos came back." } end sub
sub collections(key as String) user = cfGet("unsplash_user", "") if user = "" then m.top.result = { kind: "collections", ok: false, error: "Add your Unsplash username to use your collections." } return end if r = fetch("https://api.unsplash.com/users/" + user.EncodeUriComponent() + "/collections?per_page=30", key) if r.code <> 200 then m.top.result = { kind: "collections", ok: false, error: problem(r.code) } return end if cols = [] data = ParseJson(r.body) if data <> invalid then for each c in data total = 0 if c.total_photos <> invalid then total = c.total_photos title = "Collection" if c.title <> invalid then title = c.title if total > 0 and c.id <> invalid then cols.Push({ id: c.id.ToStr(), title: title, total: total }) end for end if cfSet("unsplash_cols", FormatJson(cols)) m.top.result = { kind: "collections", ok: true, count: cols.Count(), error: "" } end sub
